description: Keywords Scout queries to discover active Bluesky threads for reply drafting. systemConfig.blueskyKeywords overrides this file entirely (it REPLACES the array, so include everything you want). Retargeted 2026-08-08: the previous set was 100% builder topics (AI agents, indie hacker, solo founder, vibe coding, build in public, AI orchestration, agent framework) while the live revenue objective is obj-resume-roast-demand, whose audience is job seekers. Discovery was hunting an audience the relevance filter then rejected, so only ~1 candidate per run survived and the top of the queue was memes and politics matching the bare word 'build'. The job-seeker terms lead because they map to the objective; the two builder terms stay for camp-agent-build-log and PixelAgents. Keep this set in agreement with DOMAIN_TERMS in companyHeartbeat/bluesky-relevance.js — bluesky-keywords.test.js fails if they drift apart.
